title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AFFIRMING THE CONTINUING REGULATORY SUPERVISORY ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION, UNDER REPUBLIC ACT

text.en:
The ECs are hereby given the option to convert to stock
corporations and be registered under the Corporation Code, or to stock
cooperatives and be registered under the Cooperative Code of the
Philippines, following the National Electrification Administration (NEA)
Guidelines.
The NEA shall continue to exercise its regulatory and
supervisory authority (institutional, financial, and technical) under Republic
Act (R.A.) No. 9136; Presidential Decree (P.D.) No. 269, as amended by P.D.
No. 1645, specifically Section 3 and 5 thereof, over all ECs, registered or not
registered with the Cooperative Development Authority (CD) or the Securities
and Exchange Commission (SEC)
PaMA Hologram , 40186

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take elfect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of May
Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
_ in the year of Our
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
